messages:
emma_cs: Quick sync on Acme QBR follow-up. Deck is draft-ready but we need exec alignment + an action register. Who can take owners/dates? :spiral_calendar:

raj_csm: I'll take the exec talking points and the single-slide ask. Thinking 3 bullets: impact, risk, and the ask (dedicated pool trial + SSO pilot). I'll post a draft by EOD.

alex_se: I'll refresh the usage & latency charts. Need infra numbers (30/90 day p50/p95 + cache-hit) to embed.

mike_infra: grabbing those metrics now. Will drop p50/p95, cache-hit table, and a boiled-down incident note by 18:00 PT.

sophie_pe: For enablement I propose a 60-min workshop (demo + runbooks). I can build a playbook slide and a short live demo. Wed or Fri next week works for me.

olivia_cs: I'll collate customer feedback and update the renewal risk. Heard SSO timing is the main concern from their ops.

emma_cs: Draft action register below. Please confirm or update owners/due dates.

Action register (root):
- Emma (emma_cs): finalize slide deck and append metrics appendix. Due: 2024-12-06.
- Raj (raj_csm): draft exec talking points + 1-slide ask. Due: 2024-12-05.
- Alex (alex_se): update charts + embed infra numbers. Due: 2024-12-05.
- Mike (mike_infra): provide p50/p95 + cache-hit table + short incident summary. Due: 2024-12-04.
- Sophie (sophie_pe): schedule 60-min enablement workshop and prepare demo runbook. Due: 2024-12-07.
- Olivia (olivia_cs): capture customer objections and update renewal risk (green/amber/red). Due: 2024-12-05.

raj_csm: For the exec ask, can we include a ballpark monthly cost delta for reserved vs on-demand? Execs like simple numbers.

alex_se: @mike_infra can you add a 1-row unit economics comparison: autoscale/on-demand vs dedicated reserve?

mike_infra: yes. I'll include a short table in the appendix and a link to the raw report. p95 improved ~8% after cached-prefix changes; no major incidents in the last 90d.

sophie_pe: Proposed enablement agenda:
1) Quick recap (10m)
2) Hands-on demo: rolling update + fallback (25m)
3) Runbooks + troubleshooting patterns (15m)
4) Q&A + next steps (10m)

emma_cs: Great. Sophie please invite Acme ops, their platform lead Tom, and our SE. Add pre-reads (deck + demo credentials).

sophie_pe: Draft invite below  please review:

``
Subject: AcmeCorp enablement workshop  post-QBR next steps
Hi Tom + team,
We'd like to run a 60-minute enablement workshop to walk through the integration runbook, demo best practices, and operational playbooks. Agenda attached.
Suggested times: Wed 2024-12-11 11:00 PT or Fri 2024-12-13 09:00 PT. Please let us know availability.
Thanks,
Sophie (Redwood Inference)
``

olivia_cs: thumbs up. I'll also flag legal's SCIM timing question as a P0 item in the objection list.

raj_csm: Exec bullets (short draft):
- Value: 30% faster critical-route inference and improved cache hit -> lower tail latency
- Risk: SSO rollout delay hurting onboarding velocity and usage expansion
- Ask: 2-month dedicated pool trial + SSO pilot approval + alignment on latency SLA & error-rate metric

emma_cs: Nice and tight. Keep the asks measurable. If we hit dates we can ship the exec packet on 2024-12-07 and schedule the enablement in the following week.

mike_infra: Posted metrics: https://drive.redwood/metrics/acme-30-90. I'll attach a CSV and the short notes.

alex_se: Uploaded deck v4 with Mike's numbers + cost slide: https://drive.redwood/presentations/acme-qbr-v4

calendar-bot: Event created: AcmeCorp Enablement Workshop  2024-12-11 11:00 PT (tentative). Invites sent to emma_cs, raj_csm, alex_se, olivia_cs, tom_acme.

emma_cs: Final checklist before exec send:
- [x] deck v4 uploaded
- [ ] exec talking points (raj)
- [x] infra metrics attached
- [ ] enablement invite confirmed (sophie)
- [ ] renewal risk note (olivia)

raj_csm: Dropping talking points now, will post a one-paragraph pitch and the ask slide by 17:30 PT.

olivia_cs: Renewal risk updated to AMBER. Drivers: SSO timing + muted usage growth. Recommendations: prioritize SSO pilot and runbook ops handoff.

emma_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll assemble the exec packet (deck, bullets, metrics, action register) and share on 2024-12-07. Ping if anything slips. :tada:
